faq.title: Frequently <accent>Asked Questions</accent>
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about discovering events, booking tickets, payments, and managing your orders on FlashTicket.

items.question: How do I book event tickets on FlashTicket?
items.answer: Select the event you want to attend, choose your ticket tier or seats on the seat map (if applicable), enter attendee details, and complete online checkout. Your e-tickets will appear immediately in My Tickets.

items.question: How long are selected seats or tickets held during checkout?
items.answer: Selected tickets and seats are temporarily reserved while your payment session is active (typically 10 to 15 minutes) to prevent double booking. Unpaid reservations expire automatically.

items.question: What payment methods does FlashTicket support?
items.answer: FlashTicket supports domestic bank cards, international cards, e-wallets, and QR bank transfers through integrated payment gateways.

items.question: Is there a limit on how many tickets I can buy per order?
items.answer: Ticket purchase limits per order or per account depend on the rules configured by the event organizer for each ticket tier.

items.question: How do I confirm my order payment succeeded?
items.answer: Once the transaction is confirmed, your order status in My Orders updates to Paid and the corresponding e-tickets are issued automatically.

items.question: Where can I view my e-tickets and check-in QR codes?
items.answer: Sign in and open My Tickets from the navigation bar to access all issued tickets, QR codes, and event entry details.

items.question: What do I need to bring for venue check-in?
items.answer: Simply present your e-ticket QR code on your mobile device at the entrance. Staff will scan it for single-entry validation.

items.question: Can I transfer or share a ticket with someone else?
items.answer: Depending on the event policy, you may share an extra ticket QR with your companion. Keep your QR code private so it is not scanned by someone else first.

items.question: What happens if my QR code is exposed before the event?
items.answer: Each ticket QR code is valid only for the first successful scan, so avoid posting screenshots of your QR code publicly.

items.question: Can I cancel my ticket and request a refund after purchase?
items.answer: Paid tickets are generally non-refundable unless the specific event explicitly states a flexible cancellation policy on its detail page.

items.question: Will I receive a refund if an event is cancelled by the organizer?
items.answer: Yes. When an event cancellation is approved on the platform, an automated refund process is triggered back to your original payment method.

items.question: How long does it take to receive a refund?
items.answer: Refund processing times depend on your bank or e-wallet provider and typically take 3 to 10 business days after initiation.

items.question: What if an event changes its schedule or venue?
items.answer: Updates are posted on the event page and communicated to ticket holders. Existing tickets remain valid for the rescheduled date unless stated otherwise.

items.question: Do I need an account before purchasing tickets?
items.answer: Yes. Signing in keeps your orders, e-tickets, and payment history securely synced across all your devices.

items.question: How do I reset my password or update my profile details?
items.answer: Use the password recovery option on the sign-in screen or visit your Profile page to update your contact details.

items.question: Is my payment information stored securely?
items.answer: FlashTicket does not store raw card numbers or CVV codes. All transactions are encrypted and handled by compliant payment providers.

items.question: How do I register as an Event Organizer on FlashTicket?
items.answer: Open the Organizer page from the navigation bar, submit your organization profile, and wait for admin approval to unlock event creation tools.

items.question: Does FlashTicket support custom seat map design?
items.answer: Yes. Organizers can sell tickets by quantity or design custom stage layouts, standing/seated zones, and assign ticket tiers directly in the Seat Map Editor.

items.question: How long does event review take before publishing?
items.answer: After completing your event setup and submitting it for review, our moderation team verifies the details before the event is published publicly.

items.question: Where can organizers track ticket sales and revenue?
items.answer: Inside the Organizer Dashboard, you can view total orders, sold tickets, daily revenue charts, and per-event financial breakdowns.
